title: Real Time Industry
description: This mod automatically use native tick sprint when return back to the world, filling the blank of your leaving.
body:
Use tick sprint manually feel like cheating, so I have created a mod that does tick sprinting automatically based on the time I leave. If you leave for an hour, the mod sprint for an hour correspondingly, which is three Minecraft day.

### Things To Note
1. since this is vanilla tick sprint, the mod can't prevent the player from being attacked by monsters, nor can it stop phantom from spawning.
2. while designed for industrial AFK, you still can use it under any circumstance.
3. resources and power reserve can run out due to the fast speed
4. the speed of tick sprint depends on the speed of devices and low-end devices may take longer to run. Change time ratio in RTI_config can partially solve the problem.
